note: Committed zero-speed ship-response baseline. Regenerate intentionally after a motion change and review the Git diff; exact cells are evidence, while CI enforces broader physical invariants.
limitations: The hull is stationary in wave coordinates; surge, sway and yaw are not dynamic yet.
Sea-state purpose is environmental metadata, not a schooner safety rating.
Overtopping is the current longitudinal crown-entry detector, not a deck-water volume model.
Point acceleration and jerk are rigid-body kinematics and exclude gravity, rig flex and impacts.

configuration.headingConvention: Presentation heading is the true-style bearing the bow points toward, degrees clockwise from presentation north. Model yaw is also recorded; model yaw 0 degrees points the bow toward presentation heading 180 degrees.
